access: Previously exposed development source and response only; no new observational payload or holdout
registration: Freeze before multi-field galaxy predictions. Scalar NGC3198 residuals and conditional Solar System coupling bounds are already exposed; this is adaptive development, not confirmation.
coupling_selection: Fixed grid below the smallest conditional Cassini upper bound for each p. No coupling is chosen from these galaxy predictions. Every card is evaluated on all source/geometry variants.
reuse: All eleven source variants, 99 source/distance/inclination scenarios, 24 response radii and 97 numerical radii from the scalar predecessor, unchanged. Scalars and RAR are exact predecessor comparators, not recomputed fits.
newtonian_source: Rebuild the same plane-focused density integral and compare Newtonian force to the exact predecessor field file; evaluate its spectral coefficients on ordinary Gaussian angles for the auxiliary flux solver.

numerical_controls.normalizer: max(abs(total candidate inward force), Newtonian inward force) at each radius; retains crossings through zero without dividing by zero
numerical_controls.failed_numerical_cards: Retain full fields and failed radii; do not score an unresolved card on any scenario
numerical_controls.nonpositive_inward_force: Separate no-circular-branch outcome under this source assumption; keep every failing radius and do not convert negative squared speeds to a positive velocity

claim_ceiling: QUALITY_LIMITED_DEVELOPMENT_EVIDENCE_RETAINED; full residuals and influence checks required. No per-galaxy gravity fit, family pruning, fresh validation, or cross-regime success claim.
known_limit: The auxiliary physical correction is zero in exact spherical symmetry; existing spherical cluster-pressure predictions therefore remain unchanged.
unresolved: Inclination reprojection, warp and noncircular gas motion
Observed non-spherical cluster dynamics and lensing
